capabilities: Upload images pasted into notes to ImgBB
Upload images dragged and dropped into notes to ImgBB
Automatically delete uploaded images after a set period
Encrypt and store the ImgBB API key in settings
disambiguation: Handles images only; audio, video, and other binary formats are not uploaded.
extras: The 'How it Works' section is empty in the README; users needing audio, video, or binary upload support are directed to the author's Cloudinary Uploader plugin.
motivation: The author suggests ImgBB as a lightweight, free-or-paid option for people looking to save on local vault storage.
problem: Pasted and dropped images are saved as local files, filling up vault storage, and Obsidian offers no built-in way to host them externally.

relations.evidence: This plugin allows you to automatically upload images pasted or dragged into Obsidian directly into your ImgBB account
check out my Cloudinary Uploader for Obsidian

summary: Uploads images pasted or dragged into notes to an ImgBB account instead of storing them in the vault.
